name: davy-anti-capitulation
description: Detects social pressure patterns in user prompts and injects a reminder to prevent capitulation without new technical evidence.
reminder: ATTENTION: The user expressed disapproval. STOP. Do not reverse your previous position based on emotional pressure alone. Verify whether the user provided new technical evidence. If no new evidence was provided, defend your previous position with argument. Asking for the specific technical reason behind the disapproval is mandatory before any revision.
